name: Tsumamigui 3
source:
Akito Natsuki decides to spend his one month long summer holiday in his hometown after his workplace closes down for renovations. With no money and nothing to do he decides to take it easy. 
At home Miyuri, his sister-in-law he was once fond of, and Sayoko who always treated him like her own son, were waiting for him.
Akito tried to hide his feelings as always and acted out the part of the brother-in-law, but after a slip of the tongue his real feelings are revealed. Then his stagnant relationships with Miyuki and Sayoko start to develop again, and eventually he gets deeply involved with them.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=877358]Getchu[/url] description]
translation:
明人決定在工作場所因整修關閉的這一個月暑假回到故鄉。沒錢又無事可做的他，打算悠閒度日。

在家裡等著他的，是曾經令他心動的嫂子美由里，以及一直把他當親生兒子看待的小夜子。

明人一如既往地試圖隱藏感情，扮演好小叔子的角色，卻因一時口誤暴露了真實想法。隨後，他與美由里和小夜子停滯的關係再次開始發展，最終深深捲入她們之間。

[翻譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=877358]Getchu[/url]簡介]
